name: Saki
source:
A tiny and lively girl who comes to the island at a certain point.
In reality, she is a "legal loli" sister with astonishing youthful looks despite being the same age as Mihiro.
Her personality embodies pure innocence, possessing the power to completely shift the atmosphere of any situation.
